description: A media caption/credit policy defines per-media-type attribution rules: whether captions and credits are required, credit template format, license requirements for external sources, attribution placement, and expiry monitoring for time-limited assets.

rules.description: A media-caption-credit-policy.spec.json must exist with a non-empty mediaTypes array where each entry has a 'type' field.
Every media type must explicitly declare captionRequired and creditRequired as booleans. Undeclared policy means enforcement is inconsistent across content authors.
When creditRequired is true, a creditTemplate string must be defined. Without a template, credit formatting is inconsistent and non-auditable.
creditTemplate variables (in {braces}) must be declared in spec.templateVariables. Undefined variables produce blank or broken credit strings at runtime.
Any media type with source:'external' must declare licenseRequired:true. External media published without license tracking creates copyright liability.
When creditRequired is true, attributionPlacement must be 'inline', 'footer', or 'metadata-only'. Undeclared placement means credits may never appear in the rendered output.
Media types with licenseRequired:true and timeLimited:true must declare expiryMonitoring:true. Expired licensed content that remains published creates immediate legal exposure.
